summary: A 53-ft metal tower built in 1958 on Mount Bigelow in the Catalina Mountains; the wood cabin was removed in 2013 and the metal platform was left.

facts.design: 53-ft Army CL-100 metal tower with a 14x14 ft cab; the 2013 summary calls the cab wood R-6, the register says metal; the cab was removed in 2013, leaving the platform
facts.status_note: Cab removal began 23 April 2013 and the metal platform was left. The 2013 summary includes a photo of the platform as it looked in 2014. No later source on current state.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and the 2013 summary both give 1958 for the present tower. The 1929 steel tower bid and the 1937 50-ft tower are earlier structures; no source read says which, if any, the 1958 tower replaced.

notes_for_editor: Record height_m is 15.2 (about 50 ft); the register and the 2013 summary both give a 53-ft tower, so facts.height_m is set to 16.2. Not a record correction, but worth checking. The record's status_note cites FFLA; FFLA was not read, and the cab-removal claim rests on the GVRHC summary. The GVRHC summary is dated 2013 but has a photo captioned 2014, so the story now says the platform photo is from 2014 and says no later source gives the current state; it no longer says the tower still stands. Register says the cab is metal; the 2013 summary says wood R-6. The newspaper items come through a fan site (westlookouts) and were not checked against originals. No public-access source was found, so no access key is set. The early structures (1926 station, 1929 bid, 1937 50-ft tower) are not tied to the 1958 tower in any source read.
